title: Calling in Sick
context: Maya 身体不适，早晨致电主管 Ben，说明今天不能上班，并商量本团队的报备、交接和后续联系。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Good morning, Ben. I am not feeling well, so I cannot come to work today.
dialogue.zh: 早上好，Ben。我身体不舒服，所以今天不能来上班。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I am sorry you are feeling unwell, Maya. Thanks for letting me know.
dialogue.zh: Maya，听说你不舒服，我很遗憾。谢谢你告诉我。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: How should I report my absence?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: For our team, please send me a short email when you can.
dialogue.zh: 我们团队请你方便的时候给我发一封简短邮件。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I can do that. The order list is in our shared folder.
dialogue.zh: 可以。订单清单在我们的共享文件夹里。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Thanks. Does anything on it need attention today?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。上面有什么今天需要处理的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes. The Green Street order needs a final check before it goes out.
dialogue.zh: 有。Green Street 的订单发出前需要最后核对。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I will ask Lee to check it. You do not need to work on it today.
dialogue.zh: 我会请 Lee 核对。你今天不需要处理它。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thank you. When would you like me to update you?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。你希望我什么时候向你报告情况？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Could you let me know by four this afternoon about tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 你能今天下午四点前告诉我明天的情况吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, I will email you now and update you by four.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我现在给你发邮件，四点前向你报告。

expressions.zh: 打电话请病假，向单位告知因病缺勤。
expressions.example: I need to call in sick today.

expressions.zh: 报备缺勤，询问告知单位的方式。
expressions.example: How should I report my absence?

expressions.zh: 共享文件夹，团队成员可在其中查看文件。
expressions.example: The list is in our shared folder.

expressions.zh: 需要处理，指某事需要有人关注。

expressions.example: I will update you this afternoon.

pronunciation: absence 重音在第一音节 /ˈæbsəns/；update 作动词时重音在第二音节 /ʌpˈdeɪt/。练习连读 send me，同时保持两个词清楚。

practice.title: Part 1 · Work updates
practice.prompt: How do you tell someone you cannot attend an activity?
practice.answer: I tell them as soon as I can. I give a short reason and say when I can update them.

practice.title: Part 2 · A change of plans
practice.prompt: Describe a time you changed plans because you felt unwell. Explain what you did and how you told others.
practice.answer: Last spring, I woke up feeling unwell on a workday. I called my supervisor and said I could not come in. I kept the reason brief and told her where to find the list I had prepared. She arranged for a colleague to check it. Later that afternoon, I sent an update about the next day. I felt relieved because everyone knew what to do. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Sharing work
practice.prompt: Why is a clear handoff useful when someone is absent?
practice.answer: It helps others find the work and understand what needs attention. A short update can prevent delays without sharing private details.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句报备缺勤，询问方式，说明一项交接，并确认何时更新。
